gaps.lead: Somebody needs to renew this passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).

gaps.lead: It wasn't necessary for her to bring any food — there was plenty.
gaps.explanation: needn't have + participle = it wasn't necessary, but she did it.

gaps.lead: 'I never wrote that review,' the chef insisted.
The number of students is rising.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ the number of students.
gaps.explanation: 'Is rising' becomes the noun: 'an increase in'.

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: No changes will be made to this project.
gaps.hint: go ahead = proceed; according to plan
gaps.explanation: 'No changes' means the project 'will go ahead according to plan'.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: 'Started five years ago' → present perfect with 'for'.
